other_failure_modes.name: Inconsistent categorical encoding between train and test
other_failure_modes.description: Applying Pandas `.astype("category").cat.codes` (or just `.astype("category")` for LightGBM) separately to the train and test sets causes identical string categories to be mapped to different integer codes if the unique values or their frequencies differ between the sets. This completely corrupts the categorical features for the test set.

summary: The solution employs a valid 5-fold CV setup with feature engineering and an ensemble of three gradient-boosted trees. However, it suffers from a critical bug where categorical features are encoded independently for train and test sets, leading to misaligned category mappings that will severely degrade test performance. Furthermore, it introduces minor data leakage by using the combined dataset for frequency encoding and relies on an untuned, arbitrary weighted average for its final ensemble.
